**Yes, there is one candidate.** Hansen flags a tree-cover loss event in 2025 covering 13.5 ha, or 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property. It is well above the 0.5 ha minimum event size. The JRC 2020 map shows 98% of that area was forest in 2020, so the loss falls on land that was forest at the baseline.
